top_signals.title: LVMH Fashion Unit’s Return to Growth Held Back by Iran War
top_signals.summary: Sales at LVMH’s key fashion and leather goods unit, home to Louis Vuitton and Dior, barely eked out growth last quarter as the conflict in the Middle East deterred wealthy shoppers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US Stocks Erase Gains as Chipmakers Extend Losses to Third Day
top_signals.summary: US stocks fell on Monday, erasing an early morning rally as chipmakers weakened, putting the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index on pace for its third consecutive session of declines.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: 7 smuggled migrants die in sealed rail container, 11 face life sentences
top_signals.summary:
Prosecutors charged 11 people after seven migrants, including a 14-year-old, died inside a rail cargo container traveling through Texas. Each defendant faces up to life in prison if convicted.

The post 7 smuggled migrants die in sealed rail container, 11 face life sentences appeared first on FreightWaves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Amazon seeks federal approval to launch 5,105 satellites for direct-to-device network
top_signals.summary: The proposed network will partly rely on assets from Globalstar, which Amazon announced plans to acquire in April for roughly $11.6 billion.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Consolidated food supply may be worsening cyclospora outbreaks, experts say
top_signals.summary: Experts say food industry consolidation may be amplifying the cyclospora outbreak, allowing contaminated produce to spread farther.
